judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The townsfolk one-liners ('Eww!', the 'Hah, hah, hah...!' guard, the child told not to talk to outsiders) catch Nox's bit-part humour well, but the whole map leans too hard on one ogre-and-cabbage joke, the 'bought the farm' pun and the double-dash punctuation feel modern, and the two-sentence journal with a hint ('most likely asleep in the hayloft') is more helpful than Westwood's journals.
